newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian Jan month-on-month inflation 2.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian Jan month-on-month inflation 2.8 pct.

text.p: Lithuanian January prices rose 2.8 percent, the statistics office said on Thursday.
The office said in a statement it could provide no year-on-year figures because it has changed the calculation basis for the consumer price index.

It said it was now calculating from a base of 100 at end 1995 rather than a base of 100 in 1993. It said the change was made to make Lithuanian statistics conform to the standards of the European Union statistics office, Eurostat.
